items.title: John Pope Interview, 1959-05-01
items.q: By the name of Mr. Norman Cox, he's dead now. And the punk brunette, they were teachers back in those days.

ctx.x: Did your father give you lessons?
No, not my father. By the name of Mr. Norman Cox, he's dead now. And the punk brunette, they were teachers back in those days. Yes. And I felt one of those fellows.
In fact, most all of us did.
